title: Why India wants 114 more Rafales and what gives the fighter its edge
content: Dassault Aviation from France has presented its proposal for acquiring 114 Rafale jets, aimed at strengthening India’s fighter fleet and addressing existing capability shortcomings. This initiative prioritizes significant local production and the transfer of technology to India. With a unified force of 176 Rafale aircraft, both the Indian Air Force and Navy will collaborate, enhancing India's domestic aerospace manufacturing and supporting indigenous defense projects.

title: 'Write Vishwavidyalaya in Hindi': UP minister's challenge to Rahul Gandhi
content: Uttar Pradesh Energy Minister AK Sharma challenged Rahul Gandhi's Hindi language skills. He questioned Gandhi's ability to write 'Vishwavidyalaya' and identify farm crops. Sharma also discussed Uttar Pradesh's bioenergy and smart meter initiatives. The state is a leading producer of compressed biogas and aims for more growth. Investors are invited to explore Uttar Pradesh's bioenergy sector opportunities.

title: No curfew for Pakistan series, Joe Root tells England players to be 'adults'
content: Root, 35, spoke as England's dressing-room culture continues to face scrutiny following a series of off-field incidents over the past year during the tenure of former coach Brendon McCullum and former captain Ben Stokes.

title: Months after Dells' $6.25Bn ‘gift’, US Treasury sets new Trump Account paycheck rules
content: New rules from the US Treasury and IRS will allow payroll contributions to Trump Accounts. Employers can contribute up to $2,500 tax-free annually for employees' dependent children. Employees will also have the option to make pre-tax paycheck contributions directly into these accounts. Michael and Susan Dell pledged $6.25 billion to fund this child savings initiative. The proposed regulations are now open for public comment before finalization.

title: Maharashtra FDA suspends four Domino’s licences over food safety violations
content: Maharashtra FDA suspended licenses of four Domino's Pizza outlets for hygiene violations.  Action was taken against outlets in Mumbai and Satara districts.  Inspections revealed deficiencies in cleanliness, storage, and pest control measures.  A special drive covered 104 chain restaurants across Maharashtra.  Overall, 11 food business licenses were suspended after inspections.

title: East Bengal run riot in extra time to reach AFC Champions League Two group stage
content: The home side appeared set to exit the competition after trailing 0-1 with only 14 minutes of regular time remaining.

title: Ex-Microsoft CEO Steve Ballmer changes how his $8 billion philanthropy works
content: Steve and Connie Ballmer are redefining their charitable strategy. The Ballmer Group is set to detach three regional branches, allowing them to operate as independent nonprofits. This adaptation is designed to align funding strategies more closely with the needs of local communities. With over eight billion dollars donated to charity, the Ballmers will shift their emphasis toward national-level initiatives focusing on economic mobility.

title: Meet Rana, the rare Chester Zoo piglet born about the size of a grapefruit
content: In a significant conservation milestone, a rare babirusa piglet named Rana was welcomed into the world at Chester Zoo, igniting hope for the critically endangered species. With wild populations diminishing rapidly due to the threat of African swine fever, conservationists are actively collaborating with the Indonesian government to develop protective measures for these remarkable animals.

title: Oracle layoffs: Company's '6 am layoff emails' may return in next few days
content: Oracle is preparing another round of layoffs this month, with cuts reaching double-digit percentages on some teams and managers already asked to name affected employees. The company wants payroll reduced before its second quarter starts on September 1. Oracle has already shed 21,000 jobs in a year, down to 141,000 staff, as it funds a debt-heavy AI data centre buildout that burned $23.7 billion in cash last fiscal year.

title: Woman out for a drive with friend gangraped by 6 in Cuttack
content: A woman was allegedly gangraped by several men in Cuttack district on Tuesday night. The incident occurred when she and her friend stopped their vehicle near Sukarpada village. The suspects reportedly assaulted the male friend and then proceeded to assault the woman. Police have registered a case and formed multiple teams to apprehend the accused individuals. Authorities are hopeful for the swift arrest of the perpetrators involved in this crime.

title: US removed 100 outdated dams, setting a new river restoration record
content: In 2025, the US removed 100 outdated and unsafe dams across 30 states, reconnecting more than 4,893 miles of rivers, the highest number of upstream river miles restored through dam removal in a single year. The projects reopened fish habitats, improved river connectivity and addressed public safety concerns. Pennsylvania led with 14 removals, followed by Massachusetts with 11 and Vermont with nine.

title: Mexico clears 100,000 tons of sargassum as seaweed crisis hits tourism
content: In 2026, a massive expanse of Sargassum seaweed has taken over the Atlantic Ocean, wreaking havoc on coastal areas. Mexico is facing an unprecedented surge in seaweed accumulation, which is damaging its tourism sector. The foul odor has led to a notable decline in visitors, leaving local businesses in distress. Though scientists predict improvement by late autumn, a permanent solution is still unknown.

title: 'I feel bad when father sells milk': Javelin medallist says ‘searching for job’
content: Ashish Yadav’s journey from helping his father sell milk in Mirzapur to winning a World U-20 javelin silver medal has been remarkable. Training in Hisar improved his throw by nearly 20 metres, despite a knee injury. However, his family’s financial struggles continue, and he is still seeking employment. Inspired by Neeraj Chopra, Ashish now targets 80m.

title: Google Pixel 11 phones, and everything else announced at 'Made by Google 2026'
content: Google unveiled its new Pixel 11 phones and Pixel Watch 5 with significant hardware upgrades.  The Pixel 11 Pro Fold now closes flush and features brighter displays.  New AI capabilities are integrated across devices, enhancing user experiences and device performance.  The Pixel Watch 5 introduces advanced health tracking features for monthly reports.  Google's latest offerings focus on addressing user feedback and incorporating artificial intelligence.

title: Florida's 23-acre private island hits market for $12 million after 150 years
content: Nestled near Haines City, Florida, Bannon Island—a coveted private island—has hit the market after remaining in one family for four generations. The residence skillfully marries aged 19th-century cypress wood with contemporary glass elements. With additional buildings and lush landscapes, the potential for creative development is endless. It offers the perfect balance of tranquility and accessibility, keeping Orlando and Tampa just a short distance away.

title: Engineers turned dredged sediment into four new Columbia River islands
content: In an exciting environmental initiative, dredged sediment is being repurposed to form new islands aimed at habitat restoration. Engineers have meticulously placed this sediment to construct islands and adjacent channels along the river. Researchers are examining these man-made islands to gauge their impact on supporting wildlife, especially juvenile salmon. This pioneering technique may pave the way for future efforts in restoration ecology.

title: 'Leo, stay strong': Ronaldo sends message to Messi after father's death
content: Jorge Messi, 68, died last week after a long illness. Lionel Messi shared an emotional statement about his father's death on Wednesday, reflecting on his final World Cup and his wish to win the tournament for Jorge.

title: Awarapan 2 Vs Batwara 1947 advance box office: Emraan's film leads, collects Rs 2.05 cr
content: Emraan Hashmi's 'Awarapan 2' takes the lead in advance bookings, raking in Rs 2.05 crore, while Sunny Deol's 'Batwara 1947' trails with Rs 53.21 lakh. Notably, the Delhi-NCR area is driving the ticket sales for both films. Future performance at the box office will rely heavily on walk-in attendance and spontaneous bookings.

title: Who was Abbie Lainton? 16-year-old British cheerleader dies in boat accident
content: Abbie Lainton was a 16-year-old British cheerleader from Swindon who died after a boat accident during a family holiday in the Dominican Republic. She was known for cheerleading, dancing and her bright personality. Her siblings were also injured. Her family has received more than £22,000 through a fundraiser, while her former school and cheer team have paid tribute.

title: MP horror: 9-yr-old girl raped in front of brother while returning home from school
content: A nine-year-old girl was allegedly raped in Bhind district on Tuesday afternoon. Her eleven-year-old brother was assaulted when he tried to intervene and rescue his sister. The suspect, an acquaintance, offered the children a lift home from school. He then took them to a secluded area and committed the crime. Police are now searching for the absconding suspect.

title: 'I couldn't': Lionel Messi's first post since his father's death
content: Lionel Messi has broken his silence following the death of his father Jorge, sharing an emotional tribute that reveals the depth of his grief. The Argentina captain reflected on their final World Cup dream, the messages he missed after every match and his uncertainty about continuing his career. Messi also remembered Jorge as his father, friend, agent and lifelong guide.

title: English all-rounder forced to retire aged 30 after neck, spinal cord injury
content: Lamb suffered a disc herniation in his neck earlier this season, which led to a spinal cord injury. He underwent surgery last month but continued to deal with the effects of the injury. After taking medical advice, the right-arm bowler decided to retire for the sake of his long-term health.

title: 'Don't pay attention to gossip': What N Chandrasekaran told Tata Sons staff
content: Speaking at a town hall meeting held at Bombay House in the afternoon, Chandrasekaran reportedly said he had been "touched with the love and affection" shown to him by employees throughout his career and looked back on his 40-year journey with the Tata Group.

title: $1.9 million Minnesota river project restored or protected 588 acres
content: The Shell Rock River Watershed initiative in Minnesota has made significant strides by securing 588 acres of critical habitat, surpassing its original objective by 105 acres through extensive restoration work. This program focused on acquiring various properties while bolstering wetlands and prairie habitats. Backed by funding for land purchases and aquatic enhancements, these projects are vital for the future of Minnesota's fish and wildlife.

title: Harvard-IIT graduate quits 9-to-5 job and says she's not rushing back
content: Charmie Kapoor left a decade-long career after gaining significant savings and privilege. She found liberation in the absence of a structured work schedule and daily commute. Kapoor explored personal projects and gave back to her community during this period. She realized her 9 to 5 job demanded more than just core work tasks. Kapoor now prioritizes personal interests and creating on her own terms.

title: Standoff with Noel Tata: What led to N Chandrasekaran’s exit as Tata Sons chairman
content: The 63-year-old Chandrasekaran, who has been associated with the Tata Group for four decades, informed the Tata Sons board on Wednesday that he would not seek another term after his tenure expires on February 20, 2027.

title: Ralph Waldo Emerson's quote on becoming the person you are destined to be
content: Emerson’s philosophy of self-reliance urges individuals to trust their instincts while challenging conventional wisdom. He stressed the significance of nature as a source of enlightenment and rejuvenation. By advocating for personal accountability and the courage to question norms, Emerson inspired many to pursue their paths, a sentiment that resonates in contemporary discussions about individuality and freedom.

title: Cheryl Miller slams Enes Kanter, Royce White over WNBA remarks
content: Cheryl Miller strongly rejects criticism from Enes Kanter Freedom and Royce White. She believes outside voices create unnecessary negativity around the women’s basketball league. Miller prefers attention remain on players and the ongoing WNBA season competition. The league’s transgender policy should be carefully discussed during the offseason. This approach protects everyone while avoiding  unnecessary debate.

title: Donald Trump picks Giants for Super Bowl 2027, praises Jaxson Dart
content: Donald Trump has thrown his support behind the New York Giants for the Super Bowl 2027, praising quarterback Jaxson Dart at a recent gathering. This endorsement comes after a reported history between Dart and Trump’s  views. Additionally, Trump sees the New England Patriots and Los Angeles Rams as significant competitors, confirming his intent to keep a close eye on the evolving 2026 NFL season ahead.

title: Oregon's Siletz Bay digs new channels to restore 37 acres of tidal wetland
content: Efforts are underway to restore thirty-seven acres of wetlands at Siletz Bay National Wildlife Refuge. By filling in outdated drainage ditches and excavating new tidal channels, the project is set to enhance both habitat quality and water conditions for the local wildlife. The initiative seeks to revive historical floodplain areas, allowing natural tidal movements to resume.

title: Cold, snowy Wyoming winter? Meteorologist questions Farmers’ Almanac forecast
content: A meteorologist warns against trusting summer's early winter forecasts, labeling them unreliable due to changing atmospheric conditions. Citing last year's inaccurate predictions as a cautionary tale, he emphasizes that while a strong El Niño will impact winter weather, the specifics remain unclear. For more precise predictions, he recommends waiting until mid-to-late September before making any definitive forecasts.

title: Hours after Gautam Gambhir's visit to Galle, lawn mower hits the pitch
content: Sri Lanka held a closed-door practice session in Galle as India coaches Gautam Gambhir and Sitanshu Kotak briefly inspected the pitch. Groundstaff worked extensively on the surface, which could influence India’s choice between three spinners or three seamers. Rain remains a concern ahead of the Test. India will resume training Thursday after completing an intensive preparation camp in Colombo.

title: 'Delete posts, apologise': Bengal CM orders action over derogatory posts about Netaji
content: West Bengal chief minister Suvendu Adhikari has ordered action against those making offensive comments online. He has directed law enforcement to apprehend social media users who disparage historical icon Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose. Additionally, Adhikari has mandated that MLAs establish public service centers named for Netaji, each receiving thirty thousand rupees in monthly state assistance to ensure service delivery to their constituents.

title: Karnataka cabinet portfolios out: DKS keeps finance - check full list
content: Karnataka Chief Minister D K Shivakumar has allocated portfolios to twenty-three ministers. Key departments like finance and home were retained by Shivakumar himself. U T Khader received minority welfare and health, while R Ramalinga Reddy got forest. K H Muniyappa was assigned social welfare, fulfilling his lobbying efforts. The government now prepares for the monsoon session amid some internal party discontent.

title: SC indicates referring question of lead case in Krishna Janmabhoomi dispute to HC
content: The top court took note of a statement made by parties that informal discussions were on among the Hindu plaintiffs on whose suit must be considered the lead case; hearing adjourned to September 2

title: For I-Day, Reception (At Home) at Rashtrapati Bhavan to showcase country’s cultural heritage
content: Around 35 artists from the four States of Chhattisgarh, Goa, Madhya Pradesh and Maharashtra will present folk dances and musical traditions, including Maharashtra’s Lavani and Songhi Mukhawate

title: TGIIC lists Durgam Cheruvu heritage hillocks for auction
content: Rock enthusiasts say that the the entire land parcel was once declared as ‘Heritage Precincts’, owing to the existence of huge rock formations which were said to be 250 crore years old

title: India’s first ‘private, branded’ train to run as ‘Sprite’ Tejas Express
content: IRCTC awards train branding advertising rights to M/s Sprite for six months; the private train will be announced as ‘Sprite’ Tejas Express at originating and en route stations on both sides of the journey

title: NIA searches 13 locations in Tamil Nadu and Mizoram after meth seizure
content: Five locations in Mizoram and eight in Tamil Nadu were searched, leading to the seizure of several digital devices, ₹71 lakh in cash, $53,500, and 1,50,000 Myanmar Kyat in Chennai

title: Interview focused on CV, previous experience, say Ram Temple CEO candidates
content: Amid the allegations of donation theft, 16 candidates have been shortlisted from a pool of over 5,200 applicants for the position of full-time CEO of the Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Teerth Kshetra Trust in Ayodhya

title: Mumbai landslip updates: Bodies of seven deceased taken from Rajawadi Hospital; victims identified
content: The landslide was reported at Gaushiya Chawl (row tenement) in the Ashok Nagar locality of Chirag Nagar at 3.48 a.m., the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation officials said

title: Seven dead, many injured in Mumbai landslip
content: The soil and debris from the hillside collapsed onto two to three houses nearby, says BMC Mayor Ritu Tawde

title: CM Vijay is determined not to take a lot of loans: Finance Minister
content: The government has not stopped funding for schemes that directly benefit the public, says Marie Wilson

title: Centre softens stance on FCRA Bill following appeals by minority groups
content: Lok Sabha adopts the motion to send the Foreign Contribution (Regulation) Amendment Bill, 2026, to a Joint Parliamentary Committee for further review

title: Opposition accuses UDF government of   'undeclared social media emergency' in Kerala
content: LDF accuses government of removing several posts as well as news reports related to the arrest of Youth Congress leaders on synthetic drug peddling charges

title: Rajya Sabha passes Bills to change Kerala’s name, strengthen NCDC
content: The Lok Sabha passed the Kerala (Alteration of Name) Bill, 2026, on August 11. The Kerala Assembly passed a resolution in 2024, urging the Centre to bring a law to change the name of the State to Keralam

title: Palghar felt two tremors of magnitude 3.4 in an hour
content: Both tremors happened on the night of August 10. The first one was recorded at 10:04 p.m. and the second at 11 p.m., as per the data of the National Centre for Seismology

title: Develop Tirupati–Tiruvannamalai national highway, MPs urge Union Minister Gadkari
content: In a joint representation to the Union Minister for Highways, the MPs from Tirupati, Kadapa and Tiruvannamalai highlight the need to develop the highway stretch to boost temple tourism

title: Kayanad landslips revive safety concerns over abandoned quarries in Ernakulam
content: Officials inspect a water-filled abandoned quarry after residents report suspected seepage following landslips;  preliminary report rules out immediate danger while suggesting a detailed multi-department inquiry; authorities identify around 80 abandoned quarries in the district

title: Civil Surgeon faces probe over alleged use of false caste certificate
content: The former resident of Indukurpet mandal in Nellore district has been facing allegations of obtaining a false Scheduled Caste (SC) certificate around 40 years ago and rising to such a senior position using SC reservations

title: Drone helps locate woman lost overnight in Nellore forest
content: Nagadasari Ratnamma of Obulayapalle village had gone to collect firewood on Monday and spent the night under a tree; a team from the police, the Special Branch and the Forest Department found her near the Mamidikona base camp

title: Amidst tussle, NCSC panel to probe all of Centre’s de-reservation proposals from last three years
content: The NCSC and the Centre have been clashing over the issue of de-reserving government posts for the last two years with the commission saying that de-reservation proposals are often incomplete and do not reveal alternate efforts made to fill the reserved posts

title: Congress apex body to chalk out strategy to corner Centre
content: The meeting, to be chaired by Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge, is expected to review the party’s preparedness for the Assembly elections due early next year

title: Cash discovery case: Charges against Justice Yashwant Varma “proved”, says Lok Sabha panel
content: Explanation did not demonstrate candour, transparency and institutional responsibility expected of a judge in such circumstances, says three-member inquiry committee

title: With no road, Edamalakkudy man carried on bamboo stretcher for 10 km via dense forest to hospital
content: The demand of the tribal panchayat residents for a road connecting Koodallarkudy with Anakkulam, following similar incidents last year, remains unmet

title: Shortage of Onam special trains in Malabar: Kozhikode MP meets Railway Minister
content: Over 80% of the announced special services are focussed on south Kerala, while very few have been allocated to the Malabar region, says M.K. Raghavan

title: Germany would be interested in buying green hydrogen from India, says Chargé D’ Affaires
content: Georg Enzweiler, Chargé D’ Affaires of the German Mission in India explained the EU FTA would improve prospects for German companies to invest in indegenising technologies.

title: Chief Minister releases critic M. Leelvathi’s Bharathalokam
content: Writer lauded for presenting her own interpretation of the characters and moments in the Mahabharata at the age of 98

title: ‘Economic blockade’ in Assam affects life along border with Arunachal Pradesh
content: Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma says he has requested counterpart Pema Khandu to probe Monday’s firing incident and punish the culprits

title: Defence Ministry floats ₹1 lakh crore tender for 60 multirole transport aircraft for IAF
content: The aim is to replace the force’s ageing fleet of cargo and transport aircraft and expand its strategic airlift capability

title: Hit-and-run case: police custody of two suspects sought
content: A team representing the GSL Medical College, Rajamahendravaram, met Priyanka’s parents at Iklaspur in Telangana and paid floral tributes to her portrait; the police filed a fresh plea with a local court seeking police custody of two accused in the hit-and-run case

title: Rajya Sabha adjourned amid row over ‘lungiwala’ remark against CPI(M) MP John Brittas
content: Proceedings disrupted as CPI(M) MP alleges BJP’s Sushmita Dev repeatedly used the term during a debate; Chair calls for respect for regional identities and summons members for discussions

title: Amit Shah willing to have debate on student protests, Rahul Gandhi says not interested in ‘lectures’
content: Parliamentary Affairs Minister Kiren Rijiju says the government is ready to increase the time allotted for a debate on the issue

title: Amaravati to get direct connectivity with Vijayawada, Mangalagiri
content: Two steel bridges and the second phase of the Seed Access Road to be inaugurated by Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu on August 13

title: CSL delivers second ice-class vessel to German firm
content: The 7,000-tonne vessel is designed for carrying diverse cargoes, including project and heavy cargo, steel coils and containers

title: PIL filed in Madras High Court against online liquor booking facility introduced by Tasmac
content: Pattali Makkal Katchi advocate K. Balu files the case in his capacity as president of Advocates Forum for Social Justice

title: DG Prisons orders probe into source of mobile phone used by Prajwal Revanna inside Bengaluru jail
content: Director-General of Prisons and Correctional Services Alok Kumar has ordered a departmental inquiry to trace the source of the mobile phone and SIM card allegedly used by former Hassan MP and convicted sexual assault accused Prajwal Revanna inside Bengaluru Central Prison at Parappana Agrahara.

title: Adani case: U.S. Court drops charges, Rahul Gandhi attacks Modi
content: The U.S. has dismissed criminal charges against Adani Group chairman Gautam Adani, his nephew Sagar Adani and former Adani Green Energy CEO Vneet Jaain. What exactly did the U.S. case allege, why did prosecutors bring charges, and why were they dismissed?

title: Heavy monsoon and sea surges batter Kollam beach
content: Despite the escalating crisis, a multi-crore coastal protection initiative designed to halt the erosion remains caught in administrative limbo. Initiated four years ago by the Kerala Coastal Development Corporation, the project relies on offshore geo-tube technology to break wave energy underwater and promote natural sand accumulation

title: Karnataka Cabinet: On the eve of Monsoon Session, portfolios finally allocated
content: The portfolio allocation from the Governor’s Office came on the evening of August 12 as the Ministers huddled to strategise for the Legislature session commencing on August 13, 2026

title: Kerala Police reconstitute team probing attack on ED officials
content: Investigation has entered its final stages and a large team is no longer considered necessary. Most of the accused have already secured bail, while the focus of the investigation has shifted to the alleged conspiracy behind the attack

title: Mumbai Biker, 24, Dies After Trailer Rams Her. Was On Group Ride With 22 Women
content: Thakkar was first taken to a health centre in Charama for treatment. As her condition worsened, she was shifted to a private hospital in Dhamtari, where doctors examined her and confirmed that she had died from her injuries.

title: 'Corrupt': Trump Sued For Selling Early Access To Truth Social Posts
content: The lawsuit, filed in New York by The Intercept and Freedom of the Press Foundation, states that the scheme is "extraordinary, corrupt and unconstitutional."

title: Air India Downplayed Phuket Plane Failures With 'Turbulence'? What Documents Say
content: In Air India's first statement, it attributed the plane dropping 300 feet to "brief in-flight turbulence". Five hours later, in another statement it dropped the word turbulence, while downplaying the incident.

title: 2 Kanwariyas Killed, 1 Injured After Tractor Hits Them In UP
content: Superintendent of Police Saurabh Dixit said the pilgrims were walking from Panchal Ghat in Farrukhabad carrying Kanwars when the incident occurred near Jamour.

title: 10 Minutes To Reach Crash Site: New Rules For Highway Ambulances
content: The new norms give ambulances two minutes to start moving after accepting an emergency alert and an hour to get an accident victim to the nearest hospital. Delays can attract penalties of up to Rs 10,000 per incident.

title: 'Praise Be To Allah, I Think We'll Keep It': Trump Says US Has Total Control Of Hormuz
content: Trump has repeatedly claimed that the US controls the strategic waterway, which is important for the flow of energy and other commodities through the Middle East, despite the Islamic Republic's fierce rejection of the assertion.

title: Mussoorie Highway Sees 10-km Jam After Landslide, Tourists Stuck For Hours
content: Queues stretched nearly 10 kilometres, with even two-wheelers unable to squeeze through, and officials stopping movement altogether at several points as a safety measure.

title: Licences Of 3 Domino's Pizza Outlets In Mumbai Suspended Over Hygiene Issues
content: The three Mumbai outlets whose licences got suspended include - Vile Parle (West), Borivali (West), and R-City Mall, Ghatkopar (West). Additionally, the business licence of the Domino's Malkapur outlet in Satara's Karad was also suspended.

title: Reappointment, Succession Plan: 5 Takeaways From N Chandrasekaran's Statement
content: In a statement, N Chandrasekaran explained why he decided not to seek reappointment as Tata Sons chairman and also highlighted reasons for resignation, group's succession plan and leadership transition.

title: Over 7,000 minutes, Rs 175 Crore: Cost Of Monsoon Session Disruptions
content: According to available figures, 7,023 minutes have been wasted in this session. Given that the Lok Sabha incurs an expenditure of approximately Rs 2.5 lakh per minute, Rs 175 crore has been lost so far.

title: Woman, 42, Takes Car Out For Driving Practice, Drowns In Pond In Kolkata
content: As the car emerged from the water, the woman's body was found inside the car with her face towards the rear hatch and her legs near the steering wheel.

title: Bottles Of Urine, 7,000 Tonnes Trash: Haridwar's Struggle After Kanwar Yatra
content: Videos showed cleaners without gloves or masks removing bottles filled with urine, discarded clothes, and other items at Har ki Pauri in Haridwar.

title: DK Shivakumar Assigns Portfolios To New Ministers Ahead Of Assembly Session
content: B Z Zameer Ahmed Khan has been given the Housing portfolio, while Lakshman Savadi is the minister for Co-operation.

title: Air India Pilot Was Not Tested For Drugs Before Flight. What Rules Say
content: Air India's Airbus A320, VT-EXO, operating flight AI2379 from Phuket to Delhi on August 4, experienced a sudden loss of altitude of around 300 feet during cruise. The aircraft subsequently stabilised and landed safely in Delhi.

title: 'Nobody Will Be Spared': Suvendu Adhikari On BJP MP's Netaji Remark
content: Speaking to reporters at the state secretariat 'Nabanna', Suvendu Adhikari said that nobody would be spared, regardless of their political status or official identity.

title: Air India Pilot With Marijuana In His Bloodstream Was Also On Sleep Medication
content: An Air India aircraft carrying 137 passengers and eight crew members from Phuket to Delhi had suddenly lost about 300 feet of altitude on August 4, injuring at least 24 people.

content: The survivor, whose identity has been protected by law, was raped at 27 and says and it was then that she discovered what women have always known: "politics lives in the body".

title: Brother Forced To Watch As Girl, 9, Raped By Neighbour In Madhya Pradesh
content: The survivor, a student of Class 4, was returning home with her elder brother, a Class 6 student. During this time, the accused, 21, stopped them and offered a ride home on his motorcycle.
